purpose: Adaptively subdivide timed-out unit coverage shards, preserve exact failure inventories, attribute tracked mutations to isolated leaf executions, and prevent incomplete coverage data from being presented as a final threshold result.
marker_expression: not governance and not slow and not llm and not e2e
green_conditions: every selected parent unit shard is represented by completed final leaf executions
no final unit leaf times out
no final unit leaf reports test failures or errors
each leaf executes in a disposable Git worktree
no leaf mutates tracked repository files
timed-out attempt coverage data is removed before coverage combination
coverage reports and threshold evaluation run only after all unit and integration shards complete
